title: mac-slot: a malformed load reading that passes the digits-and-dots filter (a lone dot, 1.2.3) after a high one still starts the run; the header comment and a 0-second bound message are stale
evidence: tools/mac-slot.sh load filter `*[!0-9.]*` lets "." and "1.2.3" through and awk reads them as under the cap (review of PR 1405); the header still says an unreadable load does not wait; MAC_SLOT_LOAD_WAIT_SECONDS=0 prints "after 0m". Real sysctl output cannot produce the malformed reading
